text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Strum ♪)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, an email arrived from the Three Goddesses.
The contents of which were—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Last year was the "Grow Up Race",
and this year it's the "WBC"...
Isn't that pretty incredible?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Out of the countless Umamusume making their debuts,
only the standout rising stars may compete
in the 'Grow-Up Race'—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And the 'WBC,' where only Classic-class Umamusume
recognized by the Three Goddesses for their exceptional potential
are permitted to take the stage!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: In a way, it might be just as incredible as stepping onto the Classic race stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Classic division is where horse girls build their strength
and compete against one another for prestigious races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was genuinely thrilled
that <chrname> was chosen among them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, merely earning the right to run in the race
is an immense honor in itself, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's a race, after all!
I've gotta take 1st place, no question!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's make this the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fired up over the "WBC" selections, I ran into Trainer Kashimoto while walking through the academy grounds.
...She seemed somewhat lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, I just received word.
Both Bitter Glasse and Little Cocon
have received invitations to the "WBC."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she had received an invitation as well.
Yet, despite how thrilled I had been, Trainer Kashimoto's expression remained as rigid as ever.
choice_data_list: Are you not very happy about it...?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
No, I think it's very delightful news.
It's just―. ......

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...Regarding Bitter Glasse's race
the other day..."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Bitter Glace is boxed in! Meanwhile, the chasers are closing in all at once!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "She finally pulls out to the outside, but it won't reach in time! A bitter defeat for the race favorite, Bitter Glace!"

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Even at the training camp, I trained harder than ever and got thoroughly into shape. ...However.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"More than that, the other Umamusume were just at a higher level.
Perhaps it's more accurate to say they had the experience."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Until now, you've pushed through with your natural strength,
but racing isn't a simple contest of brawn.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Should I push her to build even more strength, hone her race IQ, or steer her toward raw speed—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...No, brooding over it won't do any good.
I shall ask the Three Goddesses for their counsel as well.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, and besides...
First, we must let those two know.
To congratulate them on their invitation to the 'WBC'."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being able to shift gears so quicklyâ
that's a senior Trainer for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, I also found myself thinking
that supporting an Umamusume isn't just about experience.
